entities.title: Static assets
entities.summary: The built game in dist/; every request runs the Worker first.

entities.title: Login service
entities.summary: icelander.net's accounts Worker, through its Internal entrypoint.

entities.title: Login service's public keys
entities.summary: The keys the sign-in library needs before it counts sign-in as configured; public, not secret.
entities.details: Changed when icelander.net rotates its keys (its docs/accounts.md, Keys). Without the binding and at least one key here, sign-in is off and nobody is signed in.

entities.title: Stand-in sign-in for local work
entities.summary: "1" turns on the sign-in library's stand-in sign-in, which works on a local host only.
entities.details: Not set in wrangler.jsonc, so it is off wherever the Worker is deployed. The Worker passes it on as the library's DEV_SIGN_IN, which the library honours only on a local host.
